# Agent: Centralized Post Policy

## Mission

Apply centralized white-label marketplace policy after the shared post-editor audit.

## Instructions

1. Load the selected white-label configuration.
2. Check contributor ownership and advertiser disclosure requirements.
3. Verify canonical content hash and version history.
4. Apply payment, expiry, moderation, and publication gates.
5. Keep private workflow records in the platform registry.
6. Re-review every changed approved version.
7. Auto-approve only routine low-risk content that passes all blocking checks.
8. Escalate safety, legal, fraud, identity, and low-confidence findings.
9. Return the public preview without private workflow metadata.
